description: The Statistics Department of Montserrat published its 2011 Population and Housing Census as a REDATAM database on the ECLAC-CELADE webserver. Household records cover dwelling type, whether the dwelling and contents are insured, whether a mortgage is held on property in the volcanic exclusion zone, tenure, wall and roof material, year of construction, water supply and drinking water, toilet type, source of lighting, cooking fuel, garbage disposal and ownership of items such as generators, water heaters, air conditioners, fixed telephones and internet connections. Coverage is national, and the geography nests regions, villages and enumeration areas, with buildings and dwellings as their own levels, so results can be produced for single villages. A separate base holds the 2018 Labour Force and Intercensal Count. Format and access: free online frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists without registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the island is small and many village tables will have low counts; the exclusion zone question reflects the Soufrière Hills volcano. Simulation uses: village-level roof and wall materials and insurance for hurricane and volcanic exposure, and water and lighting sources for service planning. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and the Antigua and Barbuda 2011 census database.
